title: Crawl Tactics
description:
Crawl Tactics combines classic turn-based tactics with roguelike progression. In Dungeon Mode, face challenging, ever-changing encounters as you explore procedurally generated maps. In Quest Mode, develop your village, train your mercenaries, and defend against growing enemy invasions. 

More of a fully fledged Tactical RPG battle than a puzzle game!

 

• Crawl Tactics is not a puzzle-like tactical game focused on finding one correct solution, but a turn-based strategy RPG forfans of classic, orthodox SRPGs.

• You can enjoy deep tactical gameplay that considers height differences, unit facing, weather, terrain, and more.

Combat that uses the environment and traps

• Traps and terrain affect both you and your enemies. Set grass on fire, electrocute enemies standing on water, or ignite poison clouds.

• Various interactions are possible through pushing/throwing objects and units. Push enemies off high ground or into blade traps, or roll boulders to hit them.

• You can also activate cannons or crossbow traps to damage distant enemies, and all traps can trigger in chains for satisfying results.

Growth, customization, and building the party you want

• You can freely customize skills, equipment, classes, techniques, and appearance.

• Even after clearing the main dungeon, you can continue developing your characters through New Game Plus and Reverse, which allows you to reset classes even after advancing to higher tiers.

• From a solo party to an 8-member battle party, you can build any party composition you want.

Challenging and ever-changing Dungeon Mode

Dungeon Mode lets you explore dungeons composed of multiple rooms.

Both the dungeons and the battlefields within them are procedurally generated, providing challenging and varied experiences.

Ruins, caves, catacombs, forests—each features unique climates, monsters, and environments.

Every dungeon may include hostile or friendly NPCs, special mercenaries or valuable items, and unique events such as siege battles or defense missions.

Quest Mode focused on village building and character development

• In Quest Mode, you expand your village by constructing buildings each turn and hire multiple mercenaries, sending whichever ones you choose on the quests you want.

• Rewards differ depending on the type of quest you undertake each turn, and you can also choose higher difficulties, allowing as much grinding as you prefer.

• Through village events where monsters invade at set intervals, you can engage in larger-scale battles than in standard quests.
